summary.headline: Natal Fortune and Planetary Positions
summary.text: Astrological judgments for a nocturnal nativity with Gemini rising, interpreting cadent Saturn as poverty and labor while angular Jupiter and Venus signify health, nourishment, royal support, and friends. Planetary positions, the Moon’s triplicity lords, and the Part of Fortune are listed, followed by the opening placements of another nativity with Taurus rising.
